title: Isolation of extracellular vesicles from serum or plasma using the ME Kit
protocol: Reconstitute Vn96 peptide to 2.5 μg/μl by adding 200 μl ME-buffer.
Store reconstituted Vn96 peptide at 4°C.
Transfer 200 µl of serum or plasma into a 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Add 800 µl PBS to the tube.
Mix thoroughly.
Add 5 μl protease inhibitor cocktail to the mixture.
Centrifuge for 7 minutes at 17,000 xg at room temperature to remove debris.
Transfer supernatant to a fresh tube, avoiding any pelleted material.
Add 20 μl reconstituted Vn96 peptide (or use same amount of Vn96-Scr as a negative control) to the supernatant.
Invert tube 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes on a rotator.
Centrifuge for 7 minutes at 10,000 xg at room temperature to pellet extracellular vesicles.
Carefully remove and discard supernatant.
Wash by adding 1 ml PBS and 5 μl protease inhibitor cocktail to the pelleted material.
Invert tube 10 times.
Centrifuge for 7 minutes at 10,000 xg at room temperature to pellet extracellular vesicles again.
Carefully remove and discard supernatant.
Repeat wash by adding 1 ml PBS and 5 μl protease inhibitor cocktail to the pelleted material.
Invert tube 10 times.
Centrifuge for 7 minutes at 10,000 xg at room temperature to pellet extracellular vesicles again.
Carefully remove and discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 100 μl PBS.
